provenance: Born-digital user PDF (data/input/2603.03522.pdf). Golden frozen via scripts/reprocess.py: MineruClient.load_cached + build_document with a default PipelineConfig, so meta.mineru carries no is_ocr (auto-detect lives in ingest_pdf, which reprocess bypasses) and no batch_id (load_cached never sets one).
